pokedexEntries.bk: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

pokedexEntries.wh: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

pokedexEntries.or: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

pokedexEntries.y: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

pokedexEntries.as: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

pokedexEntries.su: Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph.

pokedexEntries.mo: They hunted in flocks. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.

pokedexEntries.us: This ancient Pokémon’s plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.

pokedexEntries.um: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.

pokedexEntries.sw: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

pokedexEntries.sh: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.
